name: pico-coop
description: Pico Co-op: a browser-based multiplayer co-op platformer (Phaser + Colyseus).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:physics && npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
